title: ICD-Deepresearch：面向临床代码预测的智能体深度研究框架
summary: ICD-Deepresearch 是一种深度研究工作流，结合结构化 EHR 基础模型与语言模型，通过候选生成、证据检索和最终选择，提升 ICD 代码预测的准确性和证据可用性。在 MIMIC-III/IV 上取得显著改进，医生评估显示其检索文档更有用。
summary_en: ICD-Deepresearch is a deep research workflow combining structured EHR foundation models with language models to improve ICD code forecasting via candidate generation, evidence retrieval, and final selection, achieving significant gains on MIMIC-III/IV with higher physician-rated usefulness.
